Oliver serves high-end hobbyists and small commercial woodworking operations through its Heritage Collection of smaller-capacity tools, while its broader equipment lineup targets professional woodworking shops and industrial users.

The company’s early innovations — such as the 1908 round cutterhead that replaced hazardous square cutterheads and an early dado blade patent still in use — established a reputation for safety and durability that continues to inform its current helical cutterhead designs.
